introduction: ERC-5218 defines an interface for recording copyright licenses on-chain and tethering them to an ERC-721 NFT. It was proposed by James Grimmelmann, Yan Ji, and Tyler Kell in July 2022. Each NFT has a root license held by its owner, who may grant sublicenses that form a tree; every license points to a terms URI and can be created, transferred, revoked, or checked for activity. Note: ERC-5218 is Stagnant — it has been inactive for 6+ months and may never be finalized, but remains historically or technically significant.
designPurpose: ERC-5218 was designed to close the gap between owning an NFT and holding legal rights to the work it represents. Before it, NFT licenses lived off-chain and the token gave no indication of what rights applied, while sublicenses were untraceable and some projects minted separate NFTs to stand in for a license. By logging every license in an on-chain tree keyed by license and token identifiers, each with a terms URI and a revoker, the standard lets creators, holders, and auditors trace the full rights history through event logs.
commonUsage: ERC-5218 is intended for NFT projects that attach creative works — images, music, or other media — to their tokens and want the license to be explicit and transferable. A compliant contract inherits from ERC-721 and answers supportsInterface with 0xac7b5ca9, so marketplaces and explorers can detect license support and resolve terms from each URI. Because the specification never reached Final status, on-chain adoption is limited, and it stands mainly as a reference design for rights management.
fn.isLicenseActive.desc: Returns whether the given license is currently active. A non-existent or revoked license is inactive, and a license also counts as inactive when one of its ancestor licenses has been revoked.
fn.isLicenseActive.params.licenseId: The identifier of the license being queried.
fn.isLicenseActive.returns.active: True if the license is active, false otherwise.
fn.getLicenseIdByTokenId.desc: Returns the root license identifier tethered to the given NFT. If the NFT has no root license, a special identifier that refers to no license, such as 0, is returned.
fn.getLicenseIdByTokenId.params.tokenId: The identifier of the NFT whose root license is queried.
fn.getLicenseIdByTokenId.returns.license: The root license identifier of the NFT, or 0 if none exists.
fn.createLicense.desc: Creates a new license on an NFT and returns its identifier. A root license may be created by the NFT owner, while a sublicense may be created by the holder of the active parent license. Emits a CreateLicense event.
fn.createLicense.params.tokenId: The NFT the license is issued upon.
fn.createLicense.params.parentLicenseId: The parent license identifier, or a special value such as 0 for a root license.
fn.createLicense.params.licenseHolder: The address that will hold the new license.
fn.createLicense.params.uri: The URI pointing to the license terms.
fn.createLicense.params.revoker: The address permitted to revoke the license.
fn.createLicense.returns.licenseId: The identifier assigned to the created license.
fn.revokeLicense.desc: Revokes an active license; only the license's designated revoker may call it. Revoking a root license returns the NFT to its creator, and sublicenses under a revoked license become inactive as well.
fn.revokeLicense.params.licenseId: The identifier of the license to revoke.
fn.transferSublicense.desc: Transfers an active sublicense to a new holder; only the current holder may call it. Root licenses are not transferred this way because they move with the NFT through the ERC-721 transfer.
fn.transferSublicense.params.licenseId: The identifier of the sublicense to transfer.
fn.transferSublicense.params.licenseHold: The address of the new sublicense holder.
fn.CreateLicense.desc: Emitted when a new license is created by any mechanism, recording its identifier, the NFT, the parent license, the holder, the terms URI, and the revoker.
fn.CreateLicense.params.licenseId: The identifier of the newly created license.
fn.CreateLicense.params.tokenId: The NFT the license is issued upon.
fn.CreateLicense.params.parentLicenseId: The parent license identifier, or 0 for a root license.
fn.CreateLicense.params.licenseHolder: The address holding the new license.
fn.CreateLicense.params.uri: The URI pointing to the license terms.
fn.CreateLicense.params.revoker: The address permitted to revoke the license.
fn.RevokeLicense.desc: Emitted when a license is revoked. Under some terms a single event on an ancestor license implies revocation of all of its sublicenses.
fn.RevokeLicense.params.licenseId: The identifier of the revoked license.
fn.TransferLicense.desc: Emitted when a license is transferred to a new holder, including the root license moving with its NFT to a new owner.
fn.TransferLicense.params.licenseId: The identifier of the transferred license.
fn.TransferLicense.params.licenseHolder: The address of the new license holder.
sim.createLicenseWalkthrough.name: Create License Walkthrough
sim.createLicenseWalkthrough.desc: Follow a createLicense call from the NFT owner through storage to the license holder and the CreateLicense event.
sim.createLicenseWalkthrough.step.call: The NFT owner calls createLicense() on the contract, passing the token ID, parent license, holder, terms URI, and revoker.
sim.createLicenseWalkthrough.step.execut: The contract records a new License entry and, for a root license, links it to the NFT in the _licenseIds mapping.
sim.createLicenseWalkthrough.step.grant: The new license is assigned to the specified holder, who gains the on-chain rights described by the license URI.
sim.createLicenseWalkthrough.step.event: The contract emits CreateLicense so indexers and auditors can trace the full license tree of the NFT.
